scoring_justification: The ionization energy values are final computed results; recomputation from raw DFT artifacts is not feasible in the verifier sandbox, so result-level comparison with paper gold is used. The convergence table is scored structurally.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported defect ionization energies for V_N and C_N in monolayer h-BN.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I: V_N+1 = 2.01 eV; C_N-1 = 1.39 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published Table I.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published reference values; the reproduction target is to match them within expected DFT variability.

schema.description: Single line containing a floating-point value representing the V_N ionization energy in eV.

outputs.description: Ionization energy of the nitrogen vacancy at 15 Å vacuum.

schema.description: Single line containing a floating-point value representing the C_N ionization energy in eV.

outputs.description: Ionization energy of the carbon-on-nitrogen substitution at 15 Å vacuum.
Convergence test: IE(C_N) computed at vacuum thicknesses 10, 20, and 30 Å; the IE values must not vary by more than 0.05 eV across rows.

output_contract.notes: The first two artifacts are single-value floats compared to hidden reference values with a tolerance (±0.10 eV). The convergence table is checked for structural consistency (max variation ≤0.05 eV).

steps.description: Compare submitted V_N ionization energy to paper gold (2.01 eV)
Compare submitted C_N ionization energy to paper gold (1.39 eV)
Verify that the IE(C_N) values across vacuum thicknesses vary by no more than 0.05 eV, indicating convergence.
